abstract: An exact gcd classification across the four depth-three binary branches of classical m-ary partition congruences; the optimal divisor is determined by three terms and has a residue-dependent factor of three.
integrity: Proof uses established generating-series factorization and explicit new coefficient-ideal/valuation analysis. The numerical checker is corroboration, not independent or infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Only four shifted depth-three branches, for all integer bases m>=2; no higher-depth or individual-value assertions. Unindexed prior-equivalence risk remains.
title: Sharp universal gcds for the four depth-three branches of m-ary partition congruences
